combats.encounter: Pirate shades in the scorched cavern

entries.summary: While flying and invisible, casts Acid Splash on two minion shades; both fail their saves and take 6 acid damage each, destroying both. Becomes visible and flies back high above the floor.

Attempts a fast descent, misses the ladder and falls. Stands, moves into reach, and hits a minion with her short sword; her bird swarm destroys a second minion. The descent used her bonus action, so she cannot attack with her second sword.
Remains above the pit and hits the last minion with Eldritch Blast, destroying it.
Closes on Loria and hits with a freezing hand for 8 cold damage; her Dexterity is reduced by 2 until a short or long rest.
Attacks Loria; its 10 to hit misses.
Hits a larger shade with his infused magical weapon for 7 damage, leaving it below half health.
Attempts to attack the other nearby shade with its force attack; no successful hit or damage is established.
Remains flying and casts Acid Splash on both remaining shades; both fail their saves and take 2 acid damage each.

With her reduced Dexterity applied, hits with her first short sword for a stated 6 damage and adds her piercing swarm. The shade resists the physical damage and survives; her second sword hits and destroys it.
Hits the final shade with Eldritch Blast; the damage is sufficient to destroy it.

ending.summary: All seven pirate shades are destroyed; the final shadow dissipates under Gaudin’s blast.

combats.encounter: Pursuit and killing of Grimstone’s assistant
combats.note: Initiative begins with Gaudin alone and is set up for the reunited party at u1095–u1108; the chase remains one continuous encounter.

entries.summary: Dashes 60 feet back toward his companions and uses Misty Step for the last 30 feet, materializing by the torchlit junction.
Pursues Gaudin down the corridor; the party hears his running footsteps.
Moves into an ambush position and readies a melee attack when the approaching assistant comes into view; directs Steampup to the other side.
Takes the opposite side of the passage and readies an attack on the assistant.
Moves to a corner for line of sight and prepares to attack.
entries.note: The positioning line is labeled Unknown in the source, immediately after Gaudin asks to move.

entries.summary: Readies a crossbow shot.
Moves behind Steampup and draws her short swords.
Charges into the junction, sees the ambush and decides “Not worth it”; turns and dashes away after the readied attacks.
Fires the readied crossbow; 23 hits. The table corrects the attribution of that roll to the crossbow.
Declares a readied Eldritch Blast as the assistant enters; its individual result is not separately reported.
His readied melee attack hits for 8 damage.
The table permits its readied attack; hits for a stated 7 damage after correcting the modifier to proficiency bonus.
Her readied short-sword attack misses with 11; no bonus-action attack is allowed. Spent reactions cannot also produce opportunity attacks.
Orders Steampup to pursue the fleeing man; the alternative of tearing down the ladder is discussed but the ladder remains intact.
Pursues with its 40-foot movement and misses its bite.
Pursues and hits with Eldritch Blast, badly wounding the assistant. Half cover is discussed as +2 AC, rather than disadvantage; Gaudin is offered the clearer shot.
Chases with Steampup and fires a crossbow shot through partial cover; it misses against the adjusted AC 16.
Collapses to his knees after the blast, raises his hands and begs the party to stop and spare him.
Allows Steampup to continue the kill at the top of the round.

Its attack is initially called a miss, then corrected to a hit with +4. Leaps onto the kneeling assistant’s chest and knocks him down; his head strikes the corridor and he dies despite pleading for mercy.

ending.summary: The assistant is killed after surrendering; the party prevents him from calling for help, and the ladder is left intact.

combats.encounter: Grimstone and animated stone creatures in the laboratory

entries.summary: Tries to blast the potion in Grimstone’s hand with Eldritch Blast; the harder shot misses harmlessly.

Moves apart from the group. Uses his Dreams affinity for advantage on Ray of Sickness and hits; Grimstone fails a Constitution DC 13 save with 3, takes 9 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of Acescale’s next turn.
Cannot pass his companions in the narrow entrance. Commands Steampup to attack and readies movement to follow Gaudin into the room.
Jumps over the table and hits Grimstone with 15; the amount of damage is not stated.
Throws an explosive potion at Acescale, who fails the Dexterity save despite using Lucky and takes 12 fire damage. As a bonus action throws thick goo onto the stone spider statue.

Runs beneath the lab bench and attacks Grimstone’s ankles. Her invisible first attack has advantage and deals 5 damage plus 3 from the swarm; her second sword hits for 7. Attacking ends her invisibility.
Moves into the room to make space and hits Grimstone with Eldritch Blast for 4 force damage.
Uses his readied movement to follow Gaudin forward, enabling his next approach around the bench.
At initiative count 20 the treated statue animates into about 50 small stone spiders. Swarms Gaudin, but its 8 to hit misses.
Fires his crossbow at Grimstone and misses with a natural 1. Ducks behind a table for partial cover, stated as +2 AC and Dexterity saves.
Moves around behind Grimstone and misses with his sword.
Attacks Grimstone and misses.
Drops a potion at his feet, producing heavily obscuring poisonous smoke. Runs to the other bench beside Acescale; the obscuration prevents opportunity attacks.

Starts in the poisonous smoke and succeeds on her Constitution save with 20: no poison or damage, though she cannot see. Leaves the cloud and slides beneath the other bench; first sword misses, second hits for 9 plus 3 swarm damage.
Abandons the proposed covered Eldritch Blast and uses Sword Burst on the spider swarm. It fails a Dexterity save with 9, and about 20% of the spiders are smashed.
Hits Gaudin with 16 for 10 piercing damage.
Hits Grimstone nearly point blank with his crossbow for 11 piercing damage, then moves into contact to threaten an opportunity attack.

Fails the smoke’s Constitution save, takes 8 poison damage and is poisoned until the start of his next turn. Leaves the cloud and spends Lucky to cancel attack disadvantage as the table allows; hits Grimstone for 5 damage.
Is immune to the smoke’s poison damage and condition. Follows out of the cloud and attacks Grimstone, but misses.

Throws a fire potion at his own feet, catching the nearby combatants and himself. Dexterity DC 14: 6 fire damage on a success, 12 on a failure. Dilion saves with 16 and takes 6; Loria fails with 9 and Steampup fails with 13, each taking 12. Grimstone saves and takes 6 himself. Then throws green goo at the stone wasp.
entries.note: Acescale’s and Gaudin’s individual saving throws/damage are not stated.

entries.summary: Casts Zephyr Strike with her bonus action, then takes advantage on her normal short-sword attack and rolls a natural 20. The table doubles weapon, swarm and Zephyr dice to 4d6+2d8; the attack kills Grimstone, who had 14 HP remaining.
Hits the remaining stone spiders with Eldritch Blast, shattering more than two-thirds of them.
The surviving spiders try to bite Gaudin but cannot get past his armor.
Animates and flies at Acescale; 15 hits for 4 piercing damage. His Constitution save fails and he takes 9 poison damage, falling to 0 HP, stable but beginning to petrify.

At 0 HP cannot act and fails the next Constitution save: one further failed save would petrify him. The special poison leaves him stable without death saves; healing above 0 will halt the transformation.

Steps over Grimstone’s body and uses his last spell slot for Cure Wounds on Acescale, with healing rolled as d8+3. The stone fades; Acescale is above 0 and no longer petrifying, though restrained until his next turn.
Attacks the wasp and misses.
entries.note: “Dog dies” in this turn-ending utterance is not corroborated as a death; the source continues addressing Steampup at u1847–u1849 and confirms both dogs leave in u2166.

entries.summary: Attacks the low-flying wasp with both swords: first hits for 4 plus 4 swarm damage; second hits for 8, badly cracking it.
Tries to finish the wasp with Eldritch Blast but misses. Mage Hand is discussed as requiring an action and is not cast.
Again fails to bite Gaudin through his armor.
Hits Acescale again for 3 piercing damage; he fails a Constitution save and takes 9 poison damage, returning to 0 HP and beginning to turn to stone.
Succeeds on his subsequent Constitution save with 13 against DC 11. Remains stable at 0 HP but stops turning to stone.
Dilion attacks the wasp with his sword for a stated 7 damage when it has 8 HP remaining; the DM accepts the resolution and addresses Steampup. The wasp is defeated.
entries.note: The transcript does not separately specify the final dog attack or its damage; do not invent the missing point.

entries.summary: The DM resolves their destruction of the remaining few stone spiders before another spider attack.

ending.summary: Grimstone, the wasp and the spider swarm are defeated. Acescale ends stable at 0 HP and is no longer petrifying; the party controls the laboratory.
